Good to know

Questions,
answered.

Can I try the gym before joining?

Yes. Use the free trial form to share your details and our team can arrange an introduction to the space and a simple movement session.

Which membership is right for me?

Monthly is designed for flexibility, quarterly for building a consistent rhythm, and annual for members who are ready to make training a long-term priority.

Do I need a training plan?

Not at all. You can use the open gym independently or start with an onboarding session to help you build a plan around your goals.

Is this the final pricing?

These are editable sample prices included to demonstrate the membership experience. The gym team can update pricing, offers, benefits, and add-ons later.
